models.parameterList.frequency_penalty.d: Ee setting adjusts frequency at which model reuses specific vocabulary that undi ippatike appeared lo input. Higher values reduce likelihood yokka such repetition, while negative values unnayi opposite effect. Vocabulary penalties do kadu increase tho frequency yokka occurrence. Negative values encourage vocabulary reuse.
models.parameterList.max_tokens.desc: Ee setting defines maximum length that model can generate lo a single response. Setting a higher value allows model ki produce longer replies, while a lower value restricts length yokka response, making idi inka concise. Adjusting ee value appropriately based on different app scenarios can sahayam achieve desired response length mariyu level yokka detail.
models.parameterList.max_tokens.title: Single Response Limit
models.parameterList.presence_penalty.de: Ee setting aims ki control reuse yokka vocabulary based on its frequency lo input. Idi attempts ki vaadandi less yokka those words that appear inka frequently lo input, tho usage frequency proportional ki occurrence frequency. Vocabulary penalties increase tho frequency yokka occurrence. Negative values encourage vocabulary reuse.
models.parameterList.reasoning_effort.de: Ee setting controls intensity yokka reasoning model applies before generating a response. Low intensity prioritizes response speed mariyu saves tokens, while high intensity provides inka comprehensive reasoning but consumes inka tokens mariyu slows down response time. default value undi medium, balancing reasoning accuracy tho response speed.
models.parameterList.temperature.desc: Ee setting affects diversity yokka model's responses. Lower values lead ki inka predictable mariyu typical responses, while higher values encourage inka diverse mariyu less common responses. When set ki 0, model always gives same response ki a given input.
models.parameterList.temperature.title: Randomness
models.parameterList.title: Model Parameters
models.parameterList.top_p.desc: Ee setting limits model's selection ki a certain proportion yokka most likely vocabulary: only selecting those top words whose cumulative probability reaches P. Lower values make model's responses inka predictable, while default setting allows model ki choose nundi entire range yokka vocabulary.
models.parameterList.top_p.title: Nucleus Sampling
